name: action1-mcp
description: Every Action1 endpoint, plus fleet-wide patch and vulnerability views across all your organizations.

action1_client_id.title: ACTION1_CLIENT_ID
action1_client_id.description: Client ID from the Action1 console's API Credentials page. With ACTION1_CLIENT_SECRET, the CLI mints a bearer token automatically. Create credentials at https://www.action1.com/api-documentation/.

action1_client_secret.title: ACTION1_CLIENT_SECRET
action1_client_secret.description: Client Secret paired with ACTION1_CLIENT_ID, from the Action1 console's API Credentials page.

action1_base_url.title: Action1 API base URL
action1_base_url.description: Base URL for the Action1 API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

action1_oauth2.title: Action1 bearer token
action1_oauth2.description: Pre-minted Action1 bearer token, used instead of ACTION1_CLIENT_ID + ACTION1_CLIENT_SECRET. Leave blank when you set the client ID and secret; the CLI mints and refreshes the token itself.

action1_org_id.title: Default organization ID
action1_org_id.description: Organization ID the fleet commands scope to by default (the --org flag overrides it). Leave blank to span every organization your credentials can see.

action1_no_config_write.title: Keep credentials off disk
action1_no_config_write.description: Set to 1 to keep credentials off disk. The token cache becomes a no-op, so the connector mints a fresh token each run instead of writing one to credentials.toml. Leave blank for the default cached behaviour.

action1_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only mode
action1_mcp_read_only.description: Set to 1 to make the MCP server refuse every write: only read tools are callable. Leave blank to allow writes (each MCP write still previews first and sends only when called again with confirm set to true).

action1_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
action1_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and sync refuses to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

action1_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
action1_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Action1 requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's built-in User-Agent.

action1_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
action1_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote or hosted deployment); at least 32 characters. Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile. Leave blank to use the profile configured as default_client_profile.
